changes.subject: fix: handle recording aliases in importer
changes.rationale: Astra's identify() used info.get('artist_mbids') to build identity for fallback tracks. When two scrobbles had identical artist_mbids (e.g. collaborative tags) but different artist_name strings ('Don Omar' vs 'Don Omar • Lucenzo') with NO confirmed Recording MBID, Astra's code mapped them to the same fallback ID. Astra's own check (conflicts = {k: v for k, v in aliases.items() if len(v) > 1 and not k.startswith('mbid:')}) detected this multi-alias non-MBID collision and threw RuntimeError: IDENTITY_FAIL, halting the real pipeline. Keying fallback tracks strictly by normalized artist and normalized title prevents false-merging different artist strings without a confirmed Recording MBID.
changes.production_behaviour_detail: Prevents catastrophic false merges where two recordings with different artist names without a confirmed Recording MBID are silently merged into a single track node. Reduces fragmented aliases created when scrobblers omit artist_mbids.

changes.subject: fix: calibrate range in smoke_real and record weight update proofs
changes.rationale: In the tiny 1-day/0.05 smoke subset (394 train-seen tracks), candidate_range() with default confidence=0.35 only returned tracks already in the user's hidden positive targets. Because positives.all() was True, ranker training was skipped (0 updates) and smoke_real.py threw ENGINEERING_INCOMPLETE. Setting RangeConfig(confidence=0.1, radius=-0.25) specifically inside smoke_real.py provided negative candidates allowing 10 ranker updates, proved loss/backprop/weights_updated on all 3 components, and verified reload inference.
changes.production_behaviour_detail: Applies strictly to diagnostic smoke run (smoke_real.py). Production training (training.py) uses full DEV range calibration (calibrate_range.py) and never diagnostic smoke thresholds.
changes.test_coverage: smoke_real.py execution in run_pipeline.py smoke; guarded by production assert against diagnostic thresholds
